Each selected graph matches its source graph apart from the source's added constant labels. q-119083: integration gives y=x²+2e^{x/2}+C, and y(0)=2 gives C=0. q-8311: y=-4x+C and y(-1)=4 give C=0. q-79219: squaring and adding gives x²+y²=49. q-106049: option 2 has center (2,1), radius 2, starts at (4,1), and initially moves upward, hence counterclockwise. q-7283: x=t³+t²+C and x(2)=15 give C=3. q-7284: x=t²/8-t³/3+C and x(3)=-7 give C=7/8. q-7111: successive integration with the initial conditions gives v=t-3t²+4 and x=t²/2-t³+4t+2. q-154678 and q-158022: dividing by y² and y respectively gives the source's separated forms, on intervals where y≠0; the original equations also admit y=0. q-154367: integration gives arcsin(y)=x+C, with x+C restricted to (-π/2,π/2) because |y|<1. q-154373: integration gives y^{3/2}=x^{3/2}+C, equivalent to the selected square-root form on the real domain x≥0, y>0.
